blurb:
During this 4-hour tour, you’ll visit some of Nova Scotia’s most iconic attractions. Explore the world-famous Peggy’s Point Lighthouse at Peggy’s Cove, one of Canada’s most photographed lighthouses, and enjoy the charm of this picturesque fishing village. You’ll also visit the Swissair Flight 111 Memorial, a moving tribute overlooking the Atlantic Ocean, and the historic Titanic Cemetery in Halifax, where many victims of the RMS Titanic are laid to rest.

This tour offers a perfect combination of breathtaking coastal scenery, maritime history, and unforgettable stories, making it one of the most popular sightseeing experiences in Nova Scotia.
